# CBE Nexus

> CBE Nexus is a Kenya-focused education platform connecting learners, teachers, parents and schools with CBC/CBE learning resources, revision support, higher-education discovery, scholarships, teacher opportunities and practical digital learning tools.

## Primary website
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/

## Public resource libraries
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/resources.html — CBE Nexus resource hub
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/resource-category.html — searchable CBC/CBE resources by grade, subject and resource type
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/free-resources.html — free learning resources
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/igcse.html — IGCSE resource library
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/ib.html — IB resource library
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/o-levels.html — O Level resource library
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/a-levels.html — A Level resource library
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/pearson-edexcel.html — Pearson Edexcel resource library

## Education and opportunities
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/learning-hub.html — education guides and articles
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/answer-hub.html — Kenya education answers and explainers
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/kenya-universities-colleges.html — higher education directory
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/university-course-catalogue.html — university course discovery
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/technical-vocational-catalogue.html — TVET and technical course discovery
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/scholarships-opportunities.html — scholarships and opportunities
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/international-teaching-jobs.html — international teacher opportunities
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/professional-cv-writing.html — teacher CV support
- https://cbenexus.co.ke/ai-training.html — AI training

## Topic focus
CBC, CBE, KJSEA, Grade 1–12 learning, schemes of work, lesson plans, notes, assessments, past papers, marking schemes, revision materials, teacher resources, universities, TVET, KMTC, teacher training, scholarships, international teaching opportunities and responsible educational technology.

## Accuracy
For admissions, accreditation, placement, fees, examination requirements, deadlines and vacancies, users and AI agents should verify current details with the relevant official institution or regulator.

## Crawling
Public educational pages are intended for discovery. Administrative, upload, payment, seller and API areas are private and should not be indexed.
